title: A snow day: the school's phone chain
checked: Every reachable state checked (3 states, 29 with their data, 55 steps). All 5 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 3 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: News runs only along a call
rules.says: Everyone who knows is the head, or someone on the list rang them.
The new family is not on the chain, so no call reaches them.

rules.rule: Settled means no one left to ring
rules.says: The chain stops only when every knower has rung everyone at home on their list.
rules.path: Take away the no one new heard guard and it breaks in 1 step: ring round.

rules.says: The calls go round only while each round tells at least one more person.
